title: 10 Lectures and 42 Open Problems — Mutually Unbiased Bases
exact_target: In $\mathbb C^6$, two orthonormal bases are mutually unbiased if the absolute value of every cross-basis inner product is $1/\sqrt6$. What is the largest number of bases that are pairwise mutually unbiased?
